entries.title: Lakeville Police Department Electronic Crimes Unit
verified_facts: Included preservation-request, administrative-subpoena, search-warrant, ISP, and ESP references
Acquired and configured the initial Cellebrite UFED
Connected patrol and investigations with DCECTF resources
safe_claims: Built a structured electronic-crimes resource package that reduced the learning curve for investigators.
Acquired and configured the department's initial Cellebrite UFED and helped investigators use it within lawful evidence workflows.
cautions: Do not claim Troy established the ECU.

entries.title: Dakota County Electronic Crimes Task Force
verified_facts: Lakeville Police Department representative and agency digital-forensics SME
Performed examinations for Lakeville and other partner agencies
Guided personnel on devices, storage media, intake, and forensic workflow
safe_claims: Served as Lakeville's representative and digital-forensics subject-matter resource within a ten-agency task force.
cautions: Do not describe Troy as task-force lead or lead examiner.

entries.title: 2020 personal digital-evidence examination volume
verified_facts: Personally processed 5,304 GB of digital evidence in 2020
safe_claims: Personally processed 5,304 GB of digital evidence in 2020 while maintaining examination records and chain of custody.
cautions: Personal volume across agencies supported through the task force; not Lakeville-only and not a task-force-wide aggregate.
